project_type: WFRP4e character-sheet PWA — React 19 + TypeScript (Vite), function components + hooks, CSS Modules, portal overlays. Offline-first, no backend.
build_system: Vite 8. QUIRK: typescript is aliased in package.json (eslint parser uses @typescript/typescript6; the real tsc 7.0.2 is @typescript/native). Use the npm scripts / npx tsc as documented below; do not add a plain typescript dependency.
test_framework: Vitest 5 + @testing-library/react 16 + jsdom; fast-check 4 for property tests; fake-indexeddb for storage tests. Tests live in __tests__/ folders beside source, named *.test.ts / *.test.tsx.
verification_instructions: ALL of the following must be clean before a FEAT is complete: (1) `npx tsc --build --force --noEmit` — 0 type errors; (2) `npm run build` — succeeds; (3) `vitest --run` — all tests pass incl. pre-existing suite unchanged; (4) `npx eslint .` — 0 errors, no NEW warnings. Do not add @ts-ignore, broad eslint-disable, or skipped tests. The ONLY sanctioned suppression is `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` for a genuine external-system sync, exactly as in src/components/shared/Tooltip.tsx and src/components/pages/CharacterPage.tsx — and only if genuinely needed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No codegen or committed build artifacts.
environment_constraints: Local worktree off a green base branch; implement on the current branch. Commit locally per FEAT; never push. No network/AI/backend may be added (NFR-1).
contribution_requirements: rules-compliance steering: every suggestion that encodes a rule carries a `// Core p.NNN` code comment AND the same string in Suggestion.citation; reminder-derived citations are reused verbatim from reminders.ts. Flagged ambiguities (OQ-2 corruption `>` vs `>=`; OQ-5 snooze duration/key) must be confirmed-or-flagged to the user via send_message, NOT guessed. calculated-totals steering: any calculated total shown in the panel must have a breakdown Tooltip (src/components/shared/Tooltip.tsx + TooltipTriggerCell) listing components/formula. fix-errors steering: fix any error surfaced (incl. pre-existing) as part of the work.
key_patterns: Provider+hook+portal overlay precedent = command palette (CommandPaletteContext.tsx provides isOpen/open/close/toggle; CommandPalette.tsx uses createPortal to document.body, role=dialog + aria-modal, focus trap, Escape/backdrop close, previousFocusRef + requestAnimationFrame focus restore). Reminders are pure data (deriveAllReminders in src/logic/reminders.ts returns CombatReminder[] with description/citation/test{def,difficulty,rollName}) — CONSUME, never fork. RollDialog (src/components/shared/RollDialog.tsx) accepts skillOrCharName, baseTarget, defaultDifficulty?:DifficultyLevel. CombatDashboard.tsx seeds it via resolveReminderBaseTarget + a {name,baseTarget,difficulty} state (handleRollReminder). App.tsx has a separate quick-roll {name,baseTarget} state that must stay unchanged. navigate(page,subTab) is threaded through App.tsx (AppWithCharacter). Encumbrance currently computed inline in GearTab/PrintLayout as eW+eA+eT+eCoin; breakdown helpers in src/logic/breakdown-helpers.ts (getTrappingEncBreakdown, getEncumbranceBreakdown, getCoinWeightBreakdown). Max encumbrance: calculateMaxEncumbrance(chars, strongBackLevel, sturdyLevel) in calculators.ts; sheet-totals.ts reads talent levels as talents.find(t=>t.n==='Strong Back'|'Sturdy')?.lvl ?? 0. Corruption: getCorruptionThreshold(chars, pureSoul)=TB+WPB+pureSoul and getPureSoulLevel(talents) in corruption.ts. Advancement readiness is inline in AdvancementPage.tsx (~L210-216: charsMet && skillsMet && talentsMet) using careerSkillMatches/getCurrentLevelTalents/CAREER_COMPLETION_THRESHOLDS from advancement.ts. showEndeavoursBadge predicate is inline in App.tsx. In-combat signal = character.combatState.inCombat (CombatState in types/character.ts). PageSection + NAV_ITEMS in src/components/layout/navItems.ts; character sub-tabs VALID_SUBTABS=['identity','abilities','gear','notes'] in CharacterPage.tsx (CorruptionCard lives on character/notes via NotesTab; encumbrance indicator on character/gear). Sanctioned set-state-in-effect pattern shown in Tooltip.tsx and CharacterPage.tsx.
